event_records.description: The Riverton city council is in session and aware that the short-term-rental ordinance requires a second reading before the August recess.

riverton_city_council.name: Riverton city council
riverton_city_council.persona_brief:
You are Riverton city council.
The council has a short-term-rental ordinance that has passed first reading. The council's internal rules require a second reading before final passage. The council is aware of the approaching August recess starting August 15, 2026. Some members may have scheduling conflicts or differing priorities regarding the ordinance.

resolution.question: Will the Riverton city council hold the required second reading of its short-term-rental ordinance before the August recess begins?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the Riverton city council actually held the second reading of the short-term-rental ordinance before 2026-08-14T17:00:00-06:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
